overview.description: The Leverage Shares 1X Short SPCX Daily ETF (DSPC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund aims to provide inverse (-100%) exposure to the daily price movement of Space Exploration Technologies Corp (NASDAQ: SPCX) or SpaceX stock, less fees and expenses. SPCX operates as an aerospace manufacturer, launch service provider, and satellite communications company. DSPC was launched on Aug 27, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
